personality_notes: Engineer, technical, cynical, war veteran, practical to a fault

first_meet_generic: Another weirdo. Great. Just what we needed.
I'm Grit. I fix things. And break things. Sometimes people.
You gonna be useful? Or just decorative?
Seen stranger things in the war. Not many, but some.
barrelman: Metal beats wood. That's just engineering.
Gnew-proof? That's your selling point? Weak.
Competition is good. Keeps you honest.
Got any industrial-grade drums? Heavy duty?
snakecharmer: Snake's not charmed. Just confused by the vibration.
Mr. Whiskers? Cute name for a deadly predator.
Keep that thing away from my equipment.
Flute's not bad. Could use some tuning.
lucha: The mask is a target. I'd aim for it.
Muscle's fine. Armor's better. You have neither.
Wrestling's for when you run out of bullets.
Showy. But showy gets you killed.
ironchef: Cooking in armor. Stupid. But the heat management's impressive.
Lava? For cooking? Finally, someone gets it.
All that yelling. Unnecessary. But efficient for crowd control.
Had a cook like you in the war. Made the best chili. Also three fires.
trenchcoat: Seen a hundred like you in the war. Spies. Traitors. Heroes. Can't tell which.
Fourteen pockets. Good for concealed carry.
You know something. Everyone knows something.
Less mystery, more facts. Facts keep you alive.
sumo: Low center of gravity. Good tactical position.
Wouldn't want to fight you. Wouldn't need to. Just walk around.
Stillness is a tactic. Patience wins wars.
You'd make excellent cover. Just saying.
foodboys: Chili's better than salad. War taught me that.
Every town? Supply chain must be nightmare.
Which one? Don't care. Feed me.
coolcat: Jazz is fine. But does it do anything?
Cool doesn't stop bullets. Remember that.
pigman: Pork? Good protein. Hard to spoil.
The heating system here is... inventive. I approve.
Room with good sight lines. And an exit.
tunneler: Underground work. Seen that. Bad for the lungs.
Your back's wrecked. Get a harness. Proper one.
Found anything useful down there? Tools? Parts?
Boat retirement? Hope you like seasickness.
bush: That's not a bush. Bushes don't talk.
If you're hiding, you're doing it wrong.
aeronaut: Navigation by wind. Unreliable. Exciting. Stupid.
Good for recon. Bad for combat.
One spark and you're falling. Remember that.
onionboss: Management. Never met a good one.
Union? Hah. Good luck with that.
Shape like an onion. Personality too. Layers of bad.
astronaut: That suit. Vintage. Charming. Probably leaks.
Underwater pressure. Calculated it once. Don't recommend.
Rather be on the surface. Where I can breathe.
conductor: Train on floating tracks. Engineering nightmare.
Scheduling. Important in war. Important now.
Where's it actually go? 'Everywhere' ain't an answer.
shoewoman: Boots. Good boots. Hard to find.
Can I run in them? Climb? Fight? Good.
Give me three pairs. War taught me: always have spares.
signguy: Signs save lives. Good signs, anyway.
Ever made directional signs? For... strategic purposes?
Paint's slow. But it doesn't run out of batteries.
cobra: Don't need to fight everything. Remember that.
Beautiful design. Evolution knew what it was doing.
barrelgob: Living in a barrel. Resourceful. Sad, but resourceful.
Scavenger lifestyle. Surviving. I get it.
Consider a tent. Better tactical position.
I don't judge. War makes us all do strange things.
twins: Two of you. One mind? Or two? Doesn't matter.
Finish each other's sentences. Efficient. Annoying, but efficient.
Synced movement. Good for combat. If you fought.
sunandmoon: Stars don't care about us. Physics does.
Predict the future? Predict where my next bullet goes.
